rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by introducing a dedicated 'Proactive Market Peak Monetization' node (priority 3) that routinely captures 1.05x-1.25x cyclical premiums on uncommitted surplus rather than waiting for distress selloffs, while extending Town Shop contract fulfillment through Day 30 to lock in 2.0x-3.5x price multipliers on terminal harvests. It shatters the workforce bottleneck by slashing the hiring hurdle to a lean 1.10x wage buffer to sprint to 10 hands by Day 4-5, decouples seed purchasing so plots never sit barren, and bounds land scaling strictly to 16-18 contiguous plots only when the workforce is established. Finally, it corrects the phantom 4-unit feed reserve for zero-livestock farms, integrates fertilizer into the task pipeline, and eliminates transit lockups by harvesting adjacent ripe crops up to carry capacity while preserving urgent watering dispatches.
